item.title: Where a slow page actually comes from
item.description: A page that takes four seconds is rarely slow for the reason the first person to look at it thinks. How to find the real one, from the browser down to the query plan.

item.title: Designing for failure — cache-aside, breakers and the authorization hot path
item.description: What it actually takes to put a cache and a circuit breaker in front of an authorization check without turning a slow dependency into an outage.

item.title: Why these notes exist
item.description: Writing the thing down is how I find out whether I actually understood it.
